title: Register with phone number
why: Checks that the optional phone number is saved and not confirmed automatically.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user with valid passenger fields (Email carla.rossi@example.com, UserName carla.rossi, PassPortNumber IT5550123) and PhoneNumber +14155550123.

expect: Registration succeeds. The User row has PhoneNumber +14155550123 and PhoneNumberConfirmed false.
